query: What is the weight of a 10 kg object on Earth?
reasoning:
`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
Weight is a force (W = m × g), not the same as mass. The student only needs one recalled constant (g ≈ 9.8 m/s²) and one multiplication — so this decomposes into a recall step plus a single arithmetic step.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

REASONING:
1. Recall the acceleration due to gravity on Earth, g, in m/s² (it is 9.8).
2. Multiply 10 (the mass in kg) by 9.8 (g from step 1) to get the weight in newtons.
